say:0:1520125001:0.text: Watch out for falling rocks. By breaking them up, we could tap into their power to strike back against the Wedge of Spirit.
say:0:1520125001:0.source_cn: 小心掉落的岩块，击碎它们也许可以利用蕴含的力量反攻精神之楔。
